svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 03
svg.desc: Temple is switch-heavy. Follow the numbered rooms and mechanism markers, and regroup only after each split is complete. The party splits at room 5 into two groups working mechanisms in parallel and regroups at room 7; do not take the return warp. Traps are everywhere and a falling bell trap can kill a Force outright; learn where they are. Room 5 split: the Hildebears to the north go to a Hunter with a hit Handgun (a Force if none has dropped); everyone else heads south. Step on the button to clear the barrier and make sure everyone is past before moving on. 6a is full of traps; walk around the edge of the room. In 6b the bridge switch triggers Foie traps on both sides; crossing spawns a Hildebear, and Barta fails while you or it is on the bridge, so lure it off first. 6c: break the boxes, press the four corner buttons and kill 4 Dimenians, then go west. Rooms 6d and 6f have falling bell traps in the middle. Both groups meet in room 7. The northwest and middle buttons open the way to the healing ring in the west; the way forward is north. Room 9 needs two players: the one entering on the right (east) presses the right button of the first pair, the left of the second and the right of the third, staying until teammates pass each barrier. Do not take warp A here; it sends you back.
